crossRefs.note: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and…
Yahweh will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways…
How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and Yahweh had…
One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on…
But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not…

people.name: Ai
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua after initial defeat.

translations.web: So about three thousand men of the people went up there, and they fled before the men of Ai.
translations.bsb: So about three thousand men went up, but they fled before the men of Ai.
translations.kjv: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.
translations.asv: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.
